annotations.title: Buy a plan from the balance

description: Debits your EUR balance for a plan and returns the subscription and invoice ids and the purchased tier. Use it to buy a plan without auto-renewal. Requires `spend`. Reuse the same requestId when retrying the same purchase. The key’s monthly spending cap or an insufficient balance can refuse the purchase.

requestId.description: Your idempotency key for this purchase, using letters, digits, or . _ ~ -.
